walkthroughs.body_html:
Visual Arts Methods — a core area of Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Visual Arts Methods brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Visual Arts Methods.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

Peirce
Eco
Hjelmslev

mcqs.q: What is the significance of Duchamp's 'Fountain'?
options: It demonstrated his sculpting ability.
Using only blue and green.
It challenged the definition of art - the artist's choice, not their skill, becomes the artwork.
It is a study of plumbing.
The small projecting line at the end of letter strokes.
The space between letters.
It is a study of plumbing.
A whole typeface that looks formal.

mcqs.q: What is the central innovation of Cubism?
options: Showing an object from multiple viewpoints simultaneously on a flat surface.
Painting everything as cubes.
Using only blue and green.
It is a study of plumbing.
